name: Wall Balls
instructions: Stand facing a wall about 12-18 inches away, holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Lower into a squat position, keeping the medicine ball at chest level.
Descend until your thighs are parallel to the ground or lower.
Explosively drive through your heels to stand up.
As you reach full extension, use the momentum to throw the ball upward to a target on the wall (typically 9-10 feet high).
Catch the ball on its descent and immediately lower into the next squat.
Maintain a smooth, continuous rhythm throughout the movement.
